only-the-rating-is-cleared._: Clear the rating and leave the date, which is the half of the pair the constraint refuses. Under the CHECK this is a raw violation reaching the user — decision 90's failure — so the test must die on the clear itself.

the-no-op-is-not-a-no-op._: Remove the nothing-to-clear branch, so an unrated record takes the write path and writes an audit row for a change that did not happen. Must kill the no-op test — which exists only because the boundary-fixture rule said the suite was all on one side.
